title: Spotify — Kinetic Motion Identity
description: A mathematical motion system choreographing soundwaves, fluid typography, and acoustic energy into living digital tokens.

caseStudy.challenge: Choreographing dynamic audio-reactive typography that scales across mobile UI and billboard canvases without losing typographic legibility.
caseStudy.concept: Audio waveforms transformed into living typography. Pacing and elastic spring mechanics anchored to sonic transients.
caseStudy.motionSystem: Custom spring curves with fluid damping, responsive to BPM variations and vocal frequencies.
caseStudy.results: Selected as the core design token exploration for dynamic music visualizers.

title: Nike — High-Velocity Commercial Edit
description: High-velocity editorial pacing, speed ramp transitions, and sound-reactive typographics celebrating human momentum.

caseStudy.challenge: Capturing the breathless intensity of marathon runners at mile 20. The edit needed to feel physically demanding yet effortless in rhythm.
caseStudy.concept: Cutting precisely on athlete footsteps and respiratory cadence, allowing sound transients to drive frame transitions.
caseStudy.motionSystem: Custom speed-ramp curves matching biomechanical deceleration and explosive acceleration, paired with typographic kinetic flashes.
caseStudy.results: Hero commercial edit demonstrating retention-focused pacing and rhythmic cutting.

title: Apple Music — Visual Identity & Acoustic Waveforms
description: Visual identity and dynamic acoustic waveforms designed for immersive spatial audio campaigns and editorial artwork.

caseStudy.challenge: Visualizing multi-dimensional sound without falling back on generic equalizer bars or noisy particle clouds.
caseStudy.concept: Clean architectural light and geometric rings representing acoustic depth, clarity, and spatial separation.
caseStudy.motionSystem: Symmetrical concentric vector forms engineered for static album art and digital display formats.
caseStudy.results: Campaign key visuals developed for spatial sound album rollouts.

title: Formula 1 — High-Speed Championship Edit
description: Adrenaline-fueled sports editorial featuring split-second match cuts, telemetry sound design, and aggressive velocity pacing.

caseStudy.challenge: Conveying 300+ km/h speed without causing visual disorientation, maintaining narrative clarity across high-G cornering sequences.
caseStudy.concept: Engine RPM-driven cut frequencies. Visual cuts sync directly with gear shifts and apex curbs.
caseStudy.motionSystem: Impact cuts combined with micro-whip transitions and speed ramps.
caseStudy.results: High-impact motorsport highlight piece with seamless audio-visual lock.

title: High-Retention Vertical Narrative Edit
description: Fast-paced vertical talking-head edit optimized for retention with dynamic zooms, visual callouts, and sound accents.

caseStudy.challenge: Maintaining 80%+ audience retention over a 60-second vertical video through visual storytelling and pacing.
caseStudy.concept: No frame stays static for more than 1.5 seconds. Strategic b-roll inserts, animated graphic emphasis, and sound design.
caseStudy.motionSystem: Velocity zooms, typographic punchlines, and micro-animations guiding the viewer's eye.
caseStudy.results: High viewer completion rate and engagement across social channels.

title: Frank Ocean — Nights Kinetic Typography
description: Expressive 2D kinetic typography timed to vocal delivery, pitch bends, and beat switches.

caseStudy.challenge: Translating intimate lyrical storytelling into compelling motion without overwhelming the vocal track.
caseStudy.concept: Typography as voice. Weight, tracking, and velocity deform to mirror the vocalist's inflection.
caseStudy.motionSystem: Sub-pixel keyframe easing, spatial typography transitions, and subtle analog chromatic textures.
caseStudy.results: Widely shared typographic motion study celebrated for nuanced musical sync.

title: Frequency — Audio-Reactive Motion Identity
description: Procedural and keyframed motion graphics exploring visual rhythm, acoustic frequencies, and minimal graphic motion.

caseStudy.challenge: Creating an animated identity system that responds organically to live audio input.
caseStudy.concept: Harmonic resonance. Minimal circular waveforms that expand and pulse to bass frequencies.
caseStudy.motionSystem: Mathematical curves and easing equations governing velocity and scale.
caseStudy.results: Dynamic identity package used across stage visualizers and digital platforms.

title: The Eyes Chico — Cinema Key Art & Poster
description: High-contrast cinematic tribute poster blending modernist Swiss typography, duotone halftones, and stark visual hierarchy.

caseStudy.challenge: Reinterpreting legendary cinema iconography through a contemporary graphic design and editorial lens.
caseStudy.concept: Dramatic tension and stark contrasts. Black, ivory, and deep vermilion tones with surgical typography.
caseStudy.motionSystem: Static print artwork created at 300 DPI with custom grain textures.

title: Modernist Typographic Identity & Layout
description: Grid-based typographic architecture, asymmetric layout balance, and disciplined negative space.

caseStudy.challenge: Balancing complex hierarchy with strict minimal aesthetics.
caseStudy.concept: Negative space as form. The unprinted area is as critical as the typography itself.
caseStudy.results: Published in typography portfolios and exhibition catalogs.
